_doc: The MCP servers forge can give a project, one entry each: {"name": {"type": "stdio", "command": "...", "args": [], "env": {"TOKEN": "${NAME}"}}}. A ${NAME} in env is resolved from credentials/secrets.json when the profile is applied, and a server whose secret is missing is not written. A profile lists the servers it gets in its servers field. Keys that start with _ are documentation.
